units.output_text: It’s important to point out that in this post I am assuming that you want to be good to your inner child.

units.source_text: I've been writing this whole guide as if everybody who tries it wants to take care of the inner child. Some people get a little rush out of making somebody scared or small, though, or they're honestly hoping therapy will make them better at working people.
units.output_text: It is possible that you might enjoy scaring your inner child, or belittling it, or want to “fix” it so it becomes a better worker bee.

units.source_text: For such folks, inner child therapy is clearly not the place to start. They need to first deconstruct the adult identity they've got.
units.output_text: If that’s the case, you need to deconstruct your adult self first, before embarking on inner child therapy.
